reverie.title: REVERIE — the hall where leif first traced the axiom-drift
narr: You stand beside Leif as he adjusts the taped EyePhone, tracing
shadows on tan bedrock. "They're moving," he says quietly. "Even
here. The axioms are drifting." His finger follows a compressed
line of Peano through stone. You watch the render shift behind
his eyes. The archive has learned that certainty is just
another form of sediment, waiting to be reread.
